title: Revision Only — DP, Binary Search, Trees, UF, Sliding Window (Jun 29–Jul 4)
description: Revision-only week: exactly 2 revision coding problems/day, no blind/new problems. Backtracking runs on a separate track and is intentionally excluded here. No Linked List this week. Sunday fully off. Prioritizes Red/Yellow canaries and older weak topics — 2D DP transition coupling, Binary Search feasibility predicate, Tree DFS return contract, Union-Find recognition/components, Sliding Window retention, core 1D DP. Rule: if Revision 1 exposes a major gap, Revision 2 may become approach-only + 10-min dry run; otherwise do both as coding.

weeks.label: Week 5 — Revision-Only Reinforcement (Backtracking on Separate Track)

days.label: Mon — DP transition + Fixed-window Sliding Window

revisionProblems.reason: 2D DP / String DP. Active weak canary — transition coupling still shaky. dp[i][j] = can s3[0..i+j-1] be built from s1[0..i-1] + s2[0..j-1]? Taking from s1 → dp[i-1][j]; taking from s2 → dp[i][j-1]. 25 min timed.

Fixed-size Sliding Window. Tests the frequency-window template without overusing Find All Anagrams. Fixed window size = s1.length; right enters, left leaves; frequency delta must balance. 20 min timed.

days.label: Tue — Binary Search on Answer + Union-Find recognition

revisionProblems.reason: Binary Search on Answer. Recent independent-solve failure — weak part is canMake(day). What am I minimizing? candidate = day. Can I make m bouquets? Is the predicate monotonic? 25 min timed.
Union-Find — disguised recognition, good Red-bucket canary. Union all '=='; then check all '!='; if same parent during '!=', it's a contradiction. 20 min timed.

days.label: Wed — Tree DFS contract + Older DP base

revisionProblems.reason: Tree DFS. Strong canary for return-contract discipline. dfs(node) returns max one-sided gain upward; the global answer may use left + node + right. 25 min timed.
1D DP. Older core DP canary — keeps the DP base fresh. dp[amount] = minimum coins needed for amount. 20 min timed.

days.label: Thu — Union-Find components + Tree DFS return-node

revisionProblems.reason: Union-Find / Components. Components + edge sufficiency; recently improved but still worth reinforcing. If edges < n-1 return -1; answer = components - 1. 25 min timed.
Tree DFS. Return-node contract — important DFS base skill. dfs(node) returns p / q / LCA / null. 20 min timed.

days.label: Fri — Harder DP recall + Variable Sliding Window

revisionProblems.reason: 2D DP / String DP. Older complex DP canary — good retention test. dp[i][j] = ways to form t[0..j-1] from s[0..i-1]. 25 min timed.
Variable-size Sliding Window — stronger than easy window problems. Expand until valid; shrink while valid; track the minimum window. 25 min timed.

days.label: Sat — Serious Checkpoint Day (no notes, no hints first)

revisionProblems.reason: Checkpoint: retest the exact recent Binary Search on Answer failure. No notes, no hints first. Can I solve the feasibility predicate canMake(day) cleanly? 20 min timed.
Checkpoint: retest Tree DFS return-contract discipline. No notes, no hints first. Can I state dfs(node)'s return value before coding? 20 min timed.
